business_problem: ICIS’s role as a source of commodities intelligence makes it a vital cog as the global economy becomes ever hungrier for information.
solution_summary: ICIS’s role as a source of commodities intelligence makes it a vital cog as the global economy becomes ever hungrier for information. Based on MongoDB Atlas as its vector database, Ask ICIS is a first-of-its-kind gen AI assistant for commodity market intelligence. We have a lot of numerical data, mainly on prices and what we call fundamental data, which is based on supply and demand across different industries. But we also have a lot of content, as we have editors and journalists doing research, talking to people all the time and writing new content. MongoDB has been fundamental as a persistent layer for this transformation of ICIS’s service model and web applications. Commodities Intelligence Firm ICIS Partners with MongoDB Atlas for Industry-First gen AI Application. These powerful technologies, which could transform commodities intelligence, are included in the suite of features of MongoDB Atlas.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind ICIS's AI-powered search and assistant experiences.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs. Upstream and downstream integrations include Azure, big-data pipelines.
business_outcome: Positive adoption rates have surpassed expectations in a conservative industry, with the direction of travel clearly towards gen AI.
architecture_clues: Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for semantic or generative-AI use cases.
AI agents or assistants are layered on top of the MongoDB data platform.
The deployment integrates with big-data pipelines.
evidence_quotes: “Coming from an IoT and smart systems background, I sometimes joke that the commodities industry is not really about big data in a storage sense,”
“It's more about data quality, versus the sheer amount of data you can get from billions of sensors across the field.”
“The key point for us when building the RAG application was getting it in front of the customer as soon as we could,”
“When we go closer to customers, and transaction speeds become more important, MongoDB is becoming the default.”
